title: Special Topics in History; Sufism: Mystics in Islamic History
description: An exploration of the social and intellectual history of Sufism, the mystical tradition of Islam, from the 9th through the 20th centuries. Topics covered include key Sufi doctrines and practices, the formation and spread of Sufi paths (tariqas), Islamization, the relationship between popular religiosity and Sufism, and hagiography/sacred biography.
